name: Engine oil capacity (oil change)
notes: MA103 / MA104 flat-six (991.1 Carrera 3.4 / 3.8, naturally aspirated). After engine disassembly: 10.1 L (10.4 L for China / MA104). The 991.2 twin-turbo 3.0 (MDC/MDD), Turbo 3.8 and GT 4.0 engines differ — check the manual for those.
source: Porsche 991 Workshop Manual · WM 170155 Changing engine oil and oil filter

name: Engine oil drain plug
notes: Use a new sealing ring each time.
source: Porsche 991 Workshop Manual · WM 170155 Changing engine oil and oil filter

name: Spark plug
source: Porsche 991 Workshop Manual · spark plug replacement

name: Wheel fastening bolt
notes: Bolted wheels. Central-lock wheels (GT3 / Turbo option) use a single central bolt with a different procedure and much higher torque (central bolt spec > 400 Nm; GT3 cheese-head retaining bolts M8 = 31 Nm) — do not apply 160 Nm to a central lock.
source: Porsche 991 Workshop Manual · Removing and installing wheel

name: Brake fluid
notes: Use only new DOT 4. Each caliper has two bleeder valves — bleed at both. Bleeding / change pressure approx. 2.0 bar (29 psi).
source: Porsche 991 Workshop Manual · WM 470107 Bleeding the brake system

name: PDK transmission oil (dry fill)
notes: 7-speed PDK dual-clutch transaxle. Dry-fill capacity from the manual; a service refill (drain-and-fill) takes less. PDK uses its own approved ATF — do not substitute manual gear oil.
source: Porsche 991 Workshop Manual · PDK transmission (filling capacity)
